info.title: drillpress
info.description: Drill Press DrillPress.Cli: composable C# convention rules. All 0.0.X releases are alpha builds and may introduce breaking changes.

options.name: --rules
options.description: compiled rule DLL, or native executable. --build-host: override the packaged loader.

options.name: --config
options.description:
Repository defaults (default: nearest drillpress.json in this or a parent directory):
rules, target, properties, select, ignore, exclude; its paths are relative to its directory.
--rules and <target> replace its values; --property follows its properties. --no-config skips it.

options.name: --ignore
options.description:
Report only, or never, these comma-separated rule IDs (repeatable);
--select or --rules drops the config's select and ignore; --ignore adds. Unknown IDs fail.

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
No findings, fixes or allowance checks in matching source files, which
still inform analysis. Relative to the current directory; adds to the config's exclude.

options.name: --baseline
options.description:
Accepted state for change-aware rules: a Git revision,
or a directory holding an accepted copy of the current directory.
--property Name=Value (repeatable)  Override MSBuild properties; restore SDK targets first.

options.name: --include-referenced-projects
options.description: Also lint dependencies of a project target (default: selected project only).

options.name: --validate-compilation
options.description: Reject compiler errors.  --profile  Write phase timings to stderr.

options.name: --parallel-queries
options.description: Prepare pure, thread-safe queries concurrently; reporting and fixes remain ordered.

options.name: --stream-compilation
options.description: Compile each project in the rule bundle as soon as capture finishes it.

options.name: --explain-coverage
options.description: Show typed reasons, context identity and matching source ranges.

options.name: --explain-fixes
options.description: Show why each proposed fix without '+' was withheld.

options.name: --refresh-coverage
options.description: Rerun tests even when cached coverage inputs match.

options.name: --skip-coverage
options.description: Skip coverage rules and their test runs; output lists skipped rules.

options.name: --show-fix-complexity
options.description: Include assigned agent fix effort once per rule.
